verdict.rationale: The evidence never states the maximum concurrent requests allowed on any pricing tier or the cost of raising that cap. The Usage API reads the account's concurrency usage, which is a related monitoring feature, not documentation of per-tier limits or upgrade pricing. The only pricing evidence is the 1,000 free credits offer, which says nothing about concurrency.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap
